news.headline: Nvidia earnings to test AI boom after Huang's exit
news.summary: Nvidia reports quarterly earnings on Tuesday, its first since Jensen Huang's departure as CEO, with investors watching for signs of whether the AI boom can withstand the widening scandal that toppled him.Analysts will be watching for signs of whether Kress will slow Huang's aggressive investment strategy, which saw him commit tens of billions of dollars to AI companies.

news.headline: This Is a Huge Week for the Stock Market: Nvidia Earnings, Fed Minutes, and Anthropic’s IPO

news.headline: Wall Street futures muted as Nvidia earnings loom amid AI jitters

news.headline: Tesla board member Joe Gebbia: Nvidia should “reinstate” Jensen Huang to let investigation play out
news.summary: Joe Gebbia, the U.S. chief design officer, Airbnb cofounder, and Tesla board member, told Alyson Shontell that Nvidia should reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and then run a due diligence process. “Nvidia is one of the greatest companies ever of all time, and it got there because of founder mode,” Gebbia said at the F500 Innovation Forum.
